title: Thinking with Gaze: Sequential Eye-Tracking as Visual Reasoning Supervision for Medical VLMs
abstract: arXiv:2603.06697v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision--language models (VLMs) process images as visual tokens, yet their intermediate reasoning is often carried out in text, which can be suboptimal for visually grounded radiology tasks. Radiologists instead diagnose via sequential visual search; eye-tracking captures this process as time-ordered gaze trajectories that reveal how evidence is acquired over time. We use eye-gaze as supervision to guide VLM reasoning by introducing a small set of dedicated gaze tokens. These tokens are trained to predict gaze-selected image patch indices in temporal order, encouraging the model to follow human-like evidence acquisition and integration. Experiments on MIMIC-EYE and multiple external zero-shot benchmarks show consistent gains over baselines, achieving state-of-the-art in-domain performance and improved out-of-domain robustness. translated_title: 用目光思考：顺序眼动追踪作为医学视觉语言模型的视觉推理监督
translated_abstract: arXiv:2603.06697v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：视觉语言模型（VLMs）将图像处理为视觉标记，但其中间推理往往在文本中进行，这对于视觉基础的放射学任务可能并非最优。放射科医生通过顺序视觉搜索进行诊断；眼动追踪将这一过程捕获为时间排序的注视轨迹，揭示证据随时间获取的方式。我们使用眼动作为监督来引导VLM推理，通过引入一组专用的注视标记。这些标记被训练用于按时间顺序预测注视选中的图像补丁索引，鼓励模型遵循类似人类的证据获取与整合方式。在MIMIC-EYE和多个外部零样本基准上的实验显示，相较于基线模型持续提升，实现了域内性能的最优表现和域外鲁棒性的改善。这些结果突显了时间排序的注视作为学习视觉推理的有效监督信号。
tldr: 本文提出利用眼动追踪产生的时序注视轨迹作为监督信号，通过引入专用注视标记引导视觉语言模型按人类方式顺序推理，显著提升医学影像任务的性能与泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using temporally ordered eye-tracking gaze trajectories as supervision to guide VLM reasoning via dedicated gaze tokens, achieving state-of-the-art performance and improved robustness in medical imaging tasks.
